typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		SourceDataSetID as integer,
		SourceCompositeKey as string,
		TextTag as string,
		CreateUserID as string,
		ModifiedDate as timestamp,
		ListTag as string,
		CreateUserName as string,
		CreateDate as timestamp,
		ModifiedUserName as string,
		ModifiedUserID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		SourceDataSetID as integer,
		SourceCompositeKey as string,
		TextTag as string,
		CreateUserID as string,
		ModifiedDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		ListTag as string,
		CreateUserName as string,
		CreateDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		ModifiedUserName as string,
		ModifiedUserID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		SourceDataSetID,
		SourceCompositeKey,
		TextTag,
		CreateUserID,
		ModifiedDate,
		ListTag,
		CreateUserName,
		CreateDate,
		ModifiedUserName,
		ModifiedUserID),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
